newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH CENTRAL BANK SELLS PLN 152 MLN NBP-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH CENTRAL BANK SELLS PLN 152 MLN NBP-BILLS.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland sold 72 million zlotys worth of 91-day NBP-bills after banks bid for the same amount the central bank said.
The central bank also sold 80 million zlotys of 182-day NBP-bills after Polish banks bid for 80 million.,
The NBP offered to sell 100 million zlotys of each term.
The NBP sold 91-day paper at an average yield of 22.00 percent, up from 21.99 percent at the last auction on January 9. The average yield of 182-day bills was unchanged at 22.00 percent.
